text:
katie.d: Quick UX check on API credentials panel before design review tomorrow — rotate vs disable wording, warning prominence, empty-state guidance.

alex: drop the mock pls or paste screenshots

katie.d: summary: 1) surface a clear banner for full-scope keys above the list, 2) show Rotate inline next to each key (not hidden), 3) Rotate issues new key immediately and marks old key as 'Pending revoke 3 expires in 24h' with countdown.

maria: for countdown, backend should return exact expiry timestamp. render in an aria-live region so screen readers announce changes.

samir: don't rely on color alone for the banner 3 add icon + bold left border. countdown should announce when key becomes inactive.

katie.d: proposed disable modal copy: "Disable API key? This will immediately stop requests using this key. To replace, choose Rotate to issue a new key and keep the old one active for 24 hours."

alex: prefer heading 'Disable API key' 3 reserve 'Revoke' for audit logs so users aren't alarmed.

jordan: product note: primary CTA = 'Disable key' (destructive). Make 'Rotate key' visible as secondary. Only Owner and DevOps roles can rotate.

maria: add inline permission hint under Rotate: 'Requires Owner or DevOps 3 Learn more' and make the link keyboard-focusable.

samir: if rotation fails server-side, keep old key and show a dismissible toast with error + contact support link. toast should be aria-live polite.

katie.d: empty-state idea: 3-step mini guide instead of single button: 1) Create key, 2) Scope to least privilege, 3) Add to app. show small curl snippet and a11y note.

alex: banner copy tweak: short bullets under the red banner: Exposure: anyone with key can access data. Billing: misuse may incur charges. add 'Why restrict keys?' micro-link.

maria: a11y extras: focus should land on modal primary action; include non-color indicators for severity.

samir: eng ask: rotation endpoint should return {new_key, deprecation_window, expiry_timestamp}. prefer webhook to update countdown rather than polling.

katie.d: @alex can you confirm infra can provide expiry timestamp + webhook by EOD?

alex: will check and post back today.

deploy-bot: Reminder: design-review scheduled 2026-03-10 10:00 3 calendar invite sent.

katie.d: thanks all 3 I'll update figma with permission hint, 3-step empty-state, revised banner bullets, and rotate/disable modal copy before the review. :thumbsup:
